paper_story: Across three registered Graph-ANNS implementations spanning HNSW and Vamana-style construction, independent rebuilds materially change query-level safe budget requirements and induce source-to-target transport violations. The risk-side phenomenon is consistent across all six registered data–operator cells, while its conservative-cost consequence is operator-dependent and is not statistically resolved for the current Vamana-style implementation.
